title: UpdateAnniversaryRequest
description: Complete Anniversary V1 replacement plan. timezone is the explicit IANA timezone used to calculate the returned countdown. C++ atomically updates the Anniversary and its exclusively owned recurrence. Keeping recurrence yearly retains the active recurrence_id even when title or date changes; null-to-yearly creates a new rule; yearly-to-null clears recurrence_id and soft-deletes the old rule in the same transaction. Reminder replacement is not part of this Contract revision.

date.description: Replacement original date and, when recurring, the sole yearly month/day anchor.

recurrence.description: Yearly Anniversary recurrence intent, or null to make the Anniversary one-time. The client never sends recurrence_id; C++ decides whether to retain, create, or retire the owned rule.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by C++ to derive the local date and calculate the response countdown.
